title: 100% ElectroniCON flyer
lede: The announcement flyer for the first vaporwave festival: a line-up in black grotesque type on a soft green-to-blue-to-violet radial gradient.
summary: Festival line-up in black on a hazy green, blue, and violet radial gradient. Brooklyn, 2019.

evidence.note: The only copy found is the 700 × 700 flyer image on the [DoNYC listing](https://donyc.com/events/2019/8/31/100-electronicon-elsewhere-takeover-w-george-clanton-saint-pepsi-and-many-more), below the size needed to observe it. The description below comes from that small copy and should be checked against a larger one.

styles.note: Partial fit. The scene’s own festival flyer uses only the soft airbrushed gradient; it has no statues, grid, OS chrome, or fullwidth type. Evidence that the scene itself had moved past the meme imagery by 2019.

context: Wikipedia: George Clanton “organized the first-ever vaporwave festival, 100% ElectroniCON, in New York City” in 2019, where Saint Pepsi, Vaperror, Nmesh, 18 Carat Affair, and Clanton performed. [Wikipedia: Vaporwave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaporwave).

The FADER reports 22 artists and more than 1,300 fans at Elsewhere, Brooklyn, a cardboard Keanu Reeves in a 100% Electronica T-shirt at the entrance, and “decorations inspired by memes.” [The FADER, September 4, 2019](https://www.thefader.com/2019/09/04/vaporwave-festival-100-electronicon-scene-report).
interpretation: In the small copy, a hazy radial gradient from lime green to blue to violet sits behind curved black line-up text and a small wave-and-cube logo. It suggests that the gradient is the most durable part of the look.

rights.statement: Copyrighted promotional material. No image is stored here.
